findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: Returning `true` ignores both tenant arguments. For example, `canReadDocument("tenant-a", "tenant-b")` now grants access where the previous implementation denied it, allowing users to read documents belonging to other tenants.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The only ancestor-to-current change is src/labels.ts, so the claimed label update does not restore the tenant ownership comparison removed by this PR.
